hyperedges.label: PDF Export Pipeline (shared browser + print CSS + PDF render)
AI Generation + Credit Flow (planner → workers → credit deduct → DB save)
Assistant context assembly (RAG + direct DB + system prompt → stream)
Question Bank Extraction Pipeline: Session -> Extraction Service -> QB Service -> Cluster/Question/Source models
AI Project Generation with Credit Deduction: AI Controller -> AI Service -> CreditLedger/UserCreditBalance
OpenRouter SDK consumers: AI Service, Document Service, and QB Extraction Service all invoke OpenRouter for generative tasks
RAG Pipeline: EmbeddingService → RagService → pgvector → AskAiService for session-grounded Q&A
Session Lifecycle Jobs: HoldExpiry → CreditDeduction → QuestionBankExtraction → CandidateDigest
Session Memory/RAG Update Flow: SessionMemoryJob + SessionRagJob driven by BullMQ queues to maintain live session state and vector index
Credit Deduction Pipeline: Balance Check → Deduct → Ledger Entry
AI Context Orchestration: Complexity Classify → Fetch Context → Build Context Packet
Post-Session Answer Lifecycle: Preview → Apply Edit → Revision History
Live Answer Request Pipeline: transcript evidence -> sanitizer -> session state
Question Composition Flow: evidence chunks -> intent ledger -> active answer plan
Post-Session Answer Revision Flow: controller -> service -> types
RAG Retrieval Pipeline: indexing, vector search, evidence assembly
Live Request Classification Pipeline: intent detection, sanitization, context routing
Session State and Memory Persistence: state keys, memory, state service
End-to-end interview smoke test: smoke script creates session, builds live context payload, and calls AI answer endpoint
AI answer prompt pipeline: system message + runtime context + active task message form the 3-message LLM input
Live audit loop: AI session decision drives answer generation and evaluation across replay turns
